turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Kamala Verma?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, I am calling from the courier company. A parcel booked in your name to Cambodia has been stopped at Mumbai customs. It has five passports and two hundred grams of drugs.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What? I have not sent any parcel.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Then your Aadhaar is being misused. I am connecting you to the officer now. Please hold.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Inspector Sharma, CBI. Madam, your name is in a money-laundering case. From this moment you are under digital arrest.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Arrest? But I am at home...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not disconnect this call and do not tell anyone, not even your son. If you tell anyone, the police will come to your house today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To prove your innocence you must transfer two lakh rupees to the RBI verification account. It will be returned after the inquiry. Do it in the next thirty minutes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I need to ask my son first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No! I said this is confidential. Stay on the line and open your UPI app now.
